long_biography.plain_text:
At Salomon Brothers, Patrick McMahon spent nine years in fixed-income markets, progressing to partner and managing director. His work encompassed trading, risk and position structuring across repeated market cycles. That experience informed a habit of testing the range of possible outcomes before committing capital.

In 1995, he launched a firm with Eric Keiter and Maurice Perkins, whose surname initials formed MKP. McMahon became the only founder still at the business and developed it into a multi-billion-dollar manager. He now has final authority over portfolio construction. Away from markets, he has served Villanova University and foundations that support people with autism and children living with serious illness.
